---
title: "Among sites"
subtitle: "What the daily curves say about Montana brown trout, taken together"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("_common.R")
SITES <- CFG$sites$all
BORS  <- intersect(SITES, CFG$sites$bor %||% character(0))
```

```{r one-site, results='asis'}
if (length(SITES) < 2)
  cat("\n> **One active site.** This page compares populations, so it has nothing to\n",
      "> work with. Add sites to `CFG$sites$active` in `config_local.R` and re-run.\n\n", sep = "")
```

## 1. Which sites carry a signal at all

A cross-site synthesis that pools validated and unvalidated curves is a synthesis
of arithmetic. This table comes first for that reason.

```{r gate-tbl}
if (is.null(GATE)) NA_("validation has not been run", "R/05_validate.R") else {
  g <- GATE[grepl("^beta", GATE$form) & GATE$site %in% SITES, , drop = FALSE]
  s <- g %>% group_by(site, process) %>%
    summarise(n_years = max(n_years), r2_blocked = max(r2_blocked),
              p_value = min(p_value), passes = all(passes), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(process, desc(r2_blocked))
  TBL(s, caption = "One row per site and process. Everything below is restricted to the rows that pass.")
}
```

```{r gate-count, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(GATE)) {
  g <- GATE[grepl("^beta", GATE$form) & GATE$site %in% SITES & GATE$process == "recruitment", ]
  p <- tapply(g$passes, g$site, all)
  cat(sprintf(paste0("\n%d of %d population%s pass the recruitment gate. ",
                     "A failure is a statement about the resolution of that site's ",
                     "record, not a null effect of flow.\n\n"),
              sum(p, na.rm = TRUE), length(p), if (length(p) == 1) "" else "s"))
}
```

## 2. Do the curves agree on timing?

```{r beta-overlay, results='asis'}
FIG("09_f9a", NULL, "beta(t) across sites, on a common axis.")
FIG("09_f9b", NULL, "Where each site's benefit is concentrated.")
```

```{r beta-lag-warning, results='asis'}
cat("\n> **Read timing comparisons carefully.** Sites do not share a flow lag - it\n",
    "> comes from each IPM's own model selection. Two curves plotted on one day-of-year\n",
    "> axis may refer to different calendar years relative to the cohort, so a\n",
    "> difference in apparent timing can be a difference in lag rather than in biology.\n\n", sep = "")
```

## 3. Can a day be named, anywhere?

```{r resolution}
if (is.null(SE)) NA_("best-day intervals have not been computed", "R/06_daily_sensitivity.R") else {
  iv <- SE$intervals[SE$intervals$site %in% SITES &
                     SE$intervals$which == "most beneficial day", , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(iv)) NA_("no interval rows", "R/06_daily_sensitivity.R") else
    TBL(iv[order(iv$width_days),
           intersect(c("site","process","lo_month","median_month","hi_month",
                       "width_days","resolvable"), names(iv))],
        caption = "Width of the best-day interval. FALSE in `resolvable` means a season is the finest honest claim.")
}
```

```{r resolution-note, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(SE)) {
  iv <- SE$intervals[SE$intervals$site %in% SITES &
                     SE$intervals$which == "most beneficial day", , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(iv)) cat(sprintf(paste0("\n%d of %d site-process combinations resolve to a window ",
                                   "narrower than 90 days. Where they do not, the deliverable ",
                                   "is a season and a statement that the record cannot do better ",
                                   "- which is itself a finding about Montana flow records.\n\n"),
                            sum(iv$resolvable, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(iv)))
}
```

## 4. The management view

```{r mgmt, results='asis'}
FIG("09_f9c_management", NULL, "Benefit per cfs across sites.")
FIG("09_f9d_production", NULL, "Whole-population production response.")
```

```{r schedule-cross}
if (is.null(DW)) NA_("the decision-window schedules have not been built", "R/06b_decision_window.R") else {
  sc <- DW$schedule[DW$schedule$site %in% SITES & DW$schedule$process == "recruitment", , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(sc)) NA_("no schedule rows", "R/06b_decision_window.R") else {
    best <- sc %>% group_by(site) %>% slice_max(effect, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()
    TBL(best[, intersect(c("site","volume_af","window_days","sustained_cfs",
                           "start_date","end_date","effect","p_positive","passes"), names(best))],
        caption = "Each site's best feasible release, among the volumes and durations evaluated.")
  }
}
```

## 5. Reclamation scenarios, across sites

```{r scen-cross}
if (!length(BORS)) NA_("no active site has a BoR forecast", "R/08_scenarios_bor.R") else {
  eff <- bind_rows(lapply(BORS, function(s) {
    x <- SCEN(s); if (is.null(x)) NULL else transform(x$effects, site = s) }))
  if (is.null(eff) || !nrow(eff)) NA_("no scenario results on disk", "R/08_scenarios_bor.R") else
    TBL(eff[order(eff$effect),
            intersect(c("site","Scenario","Period","Type","process","effect",
                        "p_negative","frac_extrap","status"), names(eff))],
        caption = "Every scenario at every site with a forecast, worst first.")
}
```

```{r scen-fig, results='asis'}
FIG("09_f9e_scenarios", NULL, "Scenario effects across sites.")
```

```{r scen-missing, results='asis'}
miss <- setdiff(SITES, BORS)
if (length(miss))
  cat(sprintf(paste0("\n> **No forecast hydrograph** for: %s. Those populations are absent\n",
                     "> from this section because the question could not be asked, not\n",
                     "> because no effect was found.\n\n"), paste(miss, collapse = ", ")))
```

## 6. Equilibrium, across sites

```{r rule-cross}
rc <- bind_rows(lapply(BORS, function(s) {
  x <- RULE(s); if (is.null(x)) NULL else transform(x$summary, site = s) }))
if (is.null(rc) || !nrow(rc)) NA_("the rule-curve arm has not been run", "R/10_rulecurve.R") else
  TBL(rc[order(rc$dK_pct),
         intersect(c("site","Scenario","Period","Type","mean_Q","K","dK_pct",
                     "MS","dMS_pct","frac_K_finite"), names(rc))],
      caption = "Percent change in equilibrium abundance and maximum surplus production, worst first.")
```

## 7. What generalizes, and what does not

```{r synthesis, results='asis'}
cat("\nThree things this page is *for*, and they are claims to be argued rather than",
    "read off a table:\n\n",
    "1. **Whether the timing is shared.** If validated sites concentrate benefit in",
    "the same part of the year, that is a Montana-wide statement with a mechanism",
    "behind it. If they do not, the honest conclusion is that timing is local and",
    "each population needs its own curve.\n",
    "2. **Whether regulated and unregulated rivers differ.** The management value of",
    "the whole analysis rests on flow being movable, so a systematic difference",
    "between them is the most policy-relevant pattern available here.\n",
    "3. **Whether the sites that fail the gate share anything** - record length, gage",
    "quality, degree of regulation. A failure explained is more useful than a site",
    "quietly dropped.\n\n", sep = " ")
```
